java_locations.role: Registers Sequence, Class, Activity, Description, and State factories in a fixed order and returns the first factory that successfully consumes the complete source.
Registers explicit class declarations, package/namespace containers, and class links, so package-wrapped class sources remain consumable by the earlier Class factory.
Registers one Description command inventory for nodes, components, databases, bracket leaves, and links after Class has failed.

rust_locations.role: Approximates Java factory consumption with scores and booleans, then splits Java Description into Component and Deployment renderer models.
Treats nested component/bracket commands as a global Component override and permits shared-container evidence to win when explicit Class consumption should remain viable.

claimed_invariant: UML subtype selection follows whole-source command consumption and Java factory order, not isolated keyword ownership. A source containing explicit class declarations inside package containers remains Class whenever every line is accepted by ClassDiagramFactory. If Class rejects a mixed Description leaf, Java's unified Description factory owns the complete source; Rust's Component-versus-Deployment split must then be chosen from the whole ownership topology, with nested component syntax insufficient by itself to override deployment-oriented root nodes, databases, queues, or artifacts.
causal_divergence: The broad Deployment container-identity repair introduced a complete-command signal into Rust's score detector. A quoted package can now push a source containing six explicit class declarations into Deployment, despite Java accepting it in the earlier Class factory. Separately, component_backed_description_source includes any nested component container or bracket leaf. In a valid Description source rooted in production/database/CDN nodes, that local syntax forces Rust's Component renderer, changing SVEK node creation order and breaking an otherwise exact mixed component/deployment golden. Both errors arise because local keyword evidence substitutes for complete-factory consumption and whole-topology ownership.
planned_model_change: Give a viable explicit Class declaration source precedence over shared Description container evidence, mirroring ClassDiagramFactory order. Narrow the Component override to commands that establish Component ownership at the source/root level; allow nested component containers and bracket leaves inside deployment-oriented roots to be handled by the Deployment half when its whole-source score wins. Add direct subtype tests for package-wrapped classes, mixed node/component/database ownership, pure component roots, broad deployment identities, and explicit UseCase/Archimate competitors.
perturbation_axes: factory owner: explicit Class versus unified Description versus UseCase versus Archimate
container identity: quoted ordinary, hyphenated alias, slash-bearing bare code, and simple bare code
component syntax placement: top-level leaf, nested component container, and nested bracket leaf
deployment topology: node/database roots, queue/artifact leaves, and mixed cross-container links
scope_boundary: This mechanism owns only UML subtype/factory selection and Rust's Component-versus-Deployment split. It does not own canonical ID parsing after selection, SVEK node order inside a selected renderer, geometry, link identities, SVG metadata, painted bounds, comparator slack, baselines, park lists, error markers, or guard allow-lists.
acceptance: The package cross-connect source selects Class and returns to structural parity.
The mixed node/component/database source selects the renderer that preserves Java Description creation order and returns to structural parity.
The slash/hyphen deployment counterexamples still select Deployment with exact canonical identities.
Pure Component, UseCase, Archimate, and ordinary Class regression tests retain their current model owners.
Parser, renderer, and no-oracle metrics show no new failures, and a separate checker supplies fresh competing-factory inputs.
forbidden_approaches: special-casing golden filenames, labels, or exact score totals
adding an unexplained score constant solely to flip either known input
changing renderer geometry to compensate for the wrong selected model
changing parser identities, comparator controls, baselines, or skip rules
